title: Pitch Skill (REVISED)
revision_note: Previously assumed octave jumps were errors too readily. Now requires candidate confidence, voicing evidence, duration, and continuity before correction. Preserves raw MIDI/cents and scale alternatives.
purpose: Understand pitch measurement, read continuous pitch curves, and keep the raw evidence so corrections are reversible and auditable.

representations.midi: Integer 0-127. MIDI 60 = Middle C (C4). Each +1 = one semitone up.
representations.note_name: Pitch class + octave, e.g. C4, F#3. Octave 4 = middle octave.
representations.frequency_hz: MIDI to Hz: f = 440 * 2^((midi-69)/12). Hz to MIDI: midi = 69 + 12*log2(f/440).
representations.cents: 100 cents = 1 semitone. Raw pitch should be stored as a float MIDI value plus a cents deviation, NOT just a rounded integer.

midi_to_octave_rule.formula: midi // 12 - 1 gives the octave; midi % 12 gives the pitch class (C=0, ... B=11).

pitch_curve_reading.definition: A pitch tracker (CREPE, pYIN) returns f0 over time; convert each frame to a continuous MIDI value.
pitch_curve_reading.stable_note: A horizontal stretch = one held note.
pitch_curve_reading.glide_meend: A continuous diagonal slope between stable pitches = meend/portamento.
pitch_curve_reading.vibrato_gamak: A periodic wobble around a stable pitch = vibrato or gamak.
pitch_curve_reading.octave_error: A jump of ~+/-12 semitones is a POSSIBLE octave error — confirm with confidence + continuity before collapsing. Keep the raw MIDI either way.

confidence_and_alternatives.rule: Store, per event: raw_midi_float, cents_deviation, pitch_confidence, voicing_confidence, and the nearest chromatic MIDI. Do NOT overwrite raw pitch with a hard scale quantization. Present both a chromatic view and a scale-relative (sargam) label.
confidence_and_alternatives.octave_alternatives: When pitch confidence is low, keep the octave alternative rather than guessing.

octave_stability.rule: Do NOT collapse every octave difference. Only correct when both neighbours are near, the note is isolated and brief, voicing confidence is low, and continuity strongly supports it. Otherwise preserve.
